1155d984dcd43126.description: About Seder Group Seder Group is a prominent Saudi organization that delivers integrated services across various sectors throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The group is dedicated to providing excellence, innovation, and sustainable solutions that support the Kingdom's ongoing growth and development. The Role of Senior Traffic Safety Engineer Seder Group is seeking a Senior Traffic Safety Engineer to join its team in Al Jubail, Eastern Province. This full-time role involves leading traffic safety initiatives, conducting comprehensive safety analyses, and managing the electrical design for various traffic infrastructure projects. The position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in traffic safety, signals, and lighting. Key Responsibilities Lead the roadway safety program, including crash data analysis, network screening, hot-spot identification, and countermeasure selection. Conduct and lead road safety audits and safety studies, preparing recommendations backed by crash modification factors and benefit-cost analysis. Prepare and manage applications for safety funding (*, HSIP) and support Vision Zero or Safe System initiatives. Lead electrical design for traffic signals, roadway and intersection lighting, flashing beacons, pedestrian hybrid beacons, and ITS infrastructure, including load calculations, grounding, surge protection, and backup power. Develop plans, specifications, and estimates (PS&E) and approve electrical details for safety improvement projects. Specify controller cabinets, detection, communications, and power equipment, and set standard details for the agency. Review signal, lighting, and safety plans from consultants, developers, and contractors, providing technical sign-off. Oversee construction support, field inspection, testing, and commissioning to confirm installations meet design intent and electrical code. Investigate high-crash locations, signal outages, and electrical failures, directing corrective action. Ensure compliance with the MUTCD, NEC, NEMA TS 2, AASHTO Highway Safety Manual, ADA/PROWAG, and local or state standards. Manage project schedules, budgets, and consultant contracts, and coordinate with utilities and other agencies. Present findings to leadership, elected officials, and the public, and respond to citizen safety concerns. Mentor and review the work of engineers and technicians, and help develop design guidelines and training. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field. A minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in traffic safety, signal, and lighting. Demonstrated ability to work in the field under varying weather conditions and near live traffic. Proven experience in analyzing crash data and applying effective safety countermeasures. Work Environment This role is based in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, and involves full-time work. The position may require field work, including exposure to varying weather conditions and proximity to live traffic.

1177b952e3e27eda.job_title: Senior Credit Cards Product & Portfolio Expert

The expert will contribute to strengthening the bank's cards capability, optimizing portfolio performance, and delivering innovative customer propositions. The role balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution across various areas, including product development, portfolio analytics, customer experience, partnerships, and change initiatives. Key Duties Support the development and execution of the bank's credit cards strategy, ensuring alignment with broader retail banking objectives. Support the identification, assessment and development of innovative ideas that enhance marketing effectiveness, operational efficiency and customer experience. Contribute to innovation pilots and initiatives, supporting activities from research and concept development through testing and evaluation. Conduct external benchmarking across leading marketing organizations, destinations, entertainment companies and relevant industries. Support innovation workshops, ideation sessions and cross-functional problem-solving activities. 1160c72e2fc276ef.description: About Penta Consulting Penta Consulting is a technology service provider and a leading outsourced partner that delivers professional and managed solutions across EMEA. 11d2401e12a0994f.description: About the Lifeguard Role Kerten Hospitality is seeking a Lifeguard to join the team at Kaynuna Beach Escape in Yanbu, Al Madinah. This full-time position requires 0-1 years of experience and focuses on ensuring guest safety in aquatic facilities. The role involves continuous monitoring of swimming areas and effective response to emergencies. About Kerten Hospitality and Kaynuna Beach Escape Kerten Hospitality (KH) operates lifestyle hospitality destinations, focusing on bespoke lodging, experiences, and communities. The company aims to optimize operations and drive profitability for investors while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. KH transforms destinations through partnerships across lodging, food & beverage, retail, entertainment, art, and wellness, building community-centric ecosystems. The group has an expanding development pipeline of over 55 lodging projects globally, representing more than 5,500 keys. Kaynuna Beach Escape, located along the shores of Yanbu, is a 30,000 sqm beachfront destination offering relaxation, entertainment, and community living. It features 150 sun loungers, 15 private cabanas, a 200-cover restaurant, a shisha lounge, a rooftop bar, a private jetty, landscaped outdoor spaces, and a sports hub. Key Responsibilities Monitor swimming areas continuously to ensure guest safety and prevent accidents. Enforce water safety rules and regulations at all times. Respond promptly and effectively to emergencies and rescue situations. Provide first aid and CPR until professional medical assistance arrives. Communicate safety guidelines clearly to guests when necessary. Conduct routine safety checks of pools and surrounding areas. Maintain cleanliness and order in all aquatic facilities. Report any safety hazards, incidents, or maintenance issues to the line manager. Assist in conducting water rescue drills and emergency training sessions. Follow all departmental policies and procedures. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Certifications in lifeguarding, first aid, and CPR are typically required for this role. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based at Kaynuna Beach Escape in Yanbu, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. Yanbu is situated on Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea coast, known for its beaches and islands, including Al-Nawras Island. The destination is served by Prince Abdul Mohsin Bin Abdulaziz International Airport (YNB), located approximately 25 km away, offering domestic flights to major cities such as Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. Compensation and Career Development Kerten Hospitality offers a competitive compensation package based on experience. 116c7db8364deaa1.description: Job description Stage -Modélisation mécanique des effets de recouvrement et surépaisseurs de matériau composite oxyd F/H Stage 6 mois Etudiant Temps complet L'utilisation des matériaux composites dans l'aéronautique civile contribue à améliorer les performances des moteurs d'avions. Leurs caractéristiques mécaniques couplées à leur légèreté ont permis aux matériaux composites à matrice organique (CMO) de substituer les solutions métalliques dans les zones froides du moteur. Les composites à matrice céramique (CMC) ont, de plus, d'excellentes propriétés thermomécaniques et thermiques qui garantissent leurs capacités de fonctionnement à des températures extrêmes. Leur utilisation dans les zones chaudes des moteurs permettrait d'augmenter significativement leur température d'utilisation, et donc, leur rendement. C'est dans ce contexte industriel que Safran CERAMICS développe de nouveaux matériaux CMC ainsi que les pièces associées. La mission sera de travailler sur l'effet de recouvrement et des surépaisseurs nécessaires au drapage des CMCs sur le comportement matériau et lien avec les calculs de justification. L'objectif de ce travail sera double : - Suivre & Réaliser des essais matériaux standards sur éprouvettes taillées dans une plaque avec des recouvrements et des surépaisseurs - Comparer le comportement observé vis-à-vis des modélisations éléments finis classiquement faites en justification au bureau d'étude - Proposer ou explorer des pistes d'amélioration ou des pistes de modification des critères de justification Une première partie consistera à récupérer l'état de l'art issu des composites à matrice organique (CMO) ou céramique (CMC) des sociétés Safran et de la littérature scientifique, et à positionner la problématique vis-à-vis des applications en cours d'étude chez Safran Ceramics, ainsi que synthétiser les différentes approches trouvées dans la bibliographie. Cette étude bibliographique pourra être menée en parallèle de la mise en place et la réalisation des essais sur éprouvettes sur nos machines d'essai à Safran Ceramics Dans un second temps, les résultats issus des essais devront être confrontés aux modélisations classiques alimentant la justification au sein du bureau d'étude. Les écarts observés devront être documentés et des pistes ou hypothèses d'amélioration de la justification ou de recommandations quant aux positionnement ou orientations des recouvrements/surépaisseurs seront proposées Enfin, une ou plusieurs pistes proposées pourront être explorées par vous afin d'améliorer la prise en compte de ces contraintes de fabrication dans le cadre de la justification des pièces CMC. Vous devrez faire preuve d'esprit de synthèse, de vision transverse, et s'adapter à l'environnement d'entreprise SAFRAN. Modélisation Corrélation essais calculs Vous êtes en formation en mécanique, modélisation des structures (éléments finis), connaissance des matériaux composite appréciée Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma
